archetypes.gather: find the resource's hotspots, feed, keep an eye out: the predators listed hunt here; the competitors eat the same cells
archetypes.drink: reach water on a rhythm; in summer the few sources draw every species, and the ambush predators, together
archetypes.hunt: find the prey (perception), close unseen, strike; the prey's game is its dual: evade
archetypes.evade: notice the predator before it is close (perception, the watchers' alarms), reach cover, keep the group together
archetypes.cache: store the resource in its season, recover it later; the competitors pilfer; a family's granary is defended together
archetypes.shelter: be in cover, a cavity, a burrow or a roost before dusk, a storm or a predator; the weather sets the pressure
archetypes.court: find and win a mate in the season: display, call, chase
archetypes.rear: keep the young fed and alive through the season: an escort game, collective where the young travel with the group
archetypes.disperse: leave the natal range and find an empty territory: a map-scale game
archetypes.watch: the collective's sentinel: someone looks up while the rest feed; an alarm sends everyone to cover
